title: ci-cd-rollback-breadcrumbs-notes-3
content:
Personal scratchpad — CI/CD rollback breadcrumbs (canary failure)

Summary:
- Canary deployment failed for release tag 2026-02-24-rc3 during staged rollout to staging/trace-route. Need to rollback to previous stable (2026-02-17-stable).
- Observed increased 5xxs in canary, latency spike, and image mismatch warnings in rollout controller.
- Working notes for reproducing, attempted commands, outputs, and hypotheses.

Timeline / breadcrumbs (notes to self):
- 2026-02-24 08:44 UTC: automated pipeline finished build -> pushed image registry.redwood.ai/redwood/inference:2026-02-24-rc3. CI job: release-pipeline #214.
- 2026-02-24 09:12 UTC: canary rollout started (k8s rolling update + traffic-splitting, 5% to canary).
- 2026-02-24 09:17 UTC: alert: canary 5xx rate > 1% (SLO trigger). Canary traffic was routed to canary pods behind envoy route "inference-v1".
- 2026-02-24 09:19 UTC: attempted auto rollback (pipeline policy) but rollback job failed with "artifact not found".

Commands I ran (and outputs):
- Check rollout status (kubectl):
  kubectl -n staging rollout status deploy/inference --watch
  Output: "Waiting for rollout to finish: 1 old replicas are pending termination" then hung.

- Tried helm rollback (release inference-staging):
  helm history inference-staging --max=10 --namespace staging
  helm rollback inference-staging 23 --namespace staging
  Output: "Rollback to revision 23 failed: failed to download "https://charts.redwood.ai/…" (404)"
  Note: the helm chart repo URL seems fine normally; suspect artifact indexing problem.

- Checked image on nodes: docker inspect registry.redwood.ai/redwood/inference:2026-02-24-rc3
  Output: "Error: manifest for registry.redwood.ai/redwood/inference:2026-02-24-rc3 not found" 
  -> Confusing because CI reported push success. Need to verify registry replication and retention.

- Looked at release pipeline artifacts in S3: s3://redwood-release-artifacts/release-pipeline/2026-02-24-rc3/
  -> files present: build.tar.gz, chart-2026-02-24-rc3.tgz, metadata.json (size 1.2KB)
  metadata.json snippet: {"image":"registry.redwood.ai/redwood/inference:2026-02-24-rc3","commit":"a1b2c3d"}
  -> But registry manifest missing. Hypothesis: CI pushed image to internal staging registry that failed to replicate to edge registry used by k8s nodes.

- Checked quay/registry logs (quick grep):
  grep "a1b2c3d" /var/log/registry/registry.log
  -> found push request at 2026-02-24T08:52:31Z with 201 but then a 502 from proxy replication to mirror1 at 08:52:35Z.

- Manual pull from node: docker pull registry.redwood.ai/redwood/inference:2026-02-24-rc3
  Output: "Error response from daemon: manifest unknown: manifest unknown"

- Reverted to known-good image: kubectl set image deploy/inference inference=registry.redwood.ai/redwood/inference:2026-02-17-stable -n staging
  kubectl rollout status deploy/inference -n staging
  Output: rollout complete, pods ready. Canary traffic rebalanced.

Hypotheses / root-cause candidates:
- 1) CI reported success on image push due to return from local registry, but replication to the region/edge registry failed -> nodes can't pull the manifest.
- 2) Tag collision: rc3 tag was previously used for a different digest and garbage collection removed manifest during short window -> manifest unknown. (less likely but check GC logs)
- 3) Chart packaging vs image mismatch: helm chart points to image tag that didn't get updated in the artifact store (metadata drift).
- 4) Network/proxy glitch between registry and mirror. Replication 502 seen in logs supports this.

Things to check next / TODOs:
- [ ] Get registry team to inspect replication logs around 08:52 UTC and confirm mirror health. (Action: @Marco)
- [ ] Check CI job logs for release-pipeline #214 to confirm push return codes and registry endpoints used. (Action: @Priya)
- [ ] Add guard in pipeline: after push, perform docker manifest inspect via the same registry endpoint used by k8s nodes (mirror host) to ensure manifest available before promote.
- [ ] Add retry logic + alert for replication 502 codes.
- [ ] Evaluate using digest-based deployments for canaries (image@sha256:...) instead of mutable tags for rollouts to avoid collision-related surprises.

Notes on artifact versioning:
- We currently tag rc builds with date + rcN: e.g., 2026-02-24-rc3. Tag is mutable. We keep 'stable' as a separate tag.
- Consider switching pipeline to produce and record the image digest (sha256) in metadata.json and use that for k8s images in the chart during canary rollout. Chart templating can accept image.digest and set imagePullPolicy: IfNotPresent? probably should be IfNotPresent for digest, but with digest use Always? Need to think through.

Rollbacks tried and notes:
- kubectl set image -> worked (quick manual override). This is the most straightforward emergency path.
- helm rollback -> failed because chart repo artifact wasn't fetchable (404). Possibly chart publishing step completed but CDN index not updated or transient 404.
- kubectl rollout undo -> didn't help (oldReplicaSet missing? because RS got GC'd).

Immediate mitigation for future canary runs (short term):
- After any push, run a quick cross-region manifest check: curl <mirror>/v2/redwood/inference/manifests/<tag> and ensure 200. If not, block promotion.
- Add a pipeline stage to "health-check registry replication".
- For critical releases, create ephemeral digest pin and use kubectl set image with digest during canary to reduce ambiguity.

Questions / unresolved:
- Why did the pipeline think push succeeded when replication 502 occurred? Where did CI get 201 from? Did it push to a local registry API that responded 201 before replication queueing? Need to audit CI registry config.
- Is GC configured aggressively on the registry? Could GC have removed the manifest before mirrors had it? Check registry GC logs.
- Why did helm rollback reference chart repo CDN and return 404? Was chart published to S3 after index update? Check CDN invalidation TTL.

Files and references I used while debugging:
- JIRA RE-682 (incident)
- Release pipeline job: https://ci.redwood.ai/job/release-pipeline/214/console
- PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/release-pipeline/pull/214
- Registry logs: /var/log/registry/registry.log (grep replication 502)
- Chart index: https://charts.redwood.ai/index.yaml (see timestamp around 2026-02-24 08:50 UTC)

Notes to self for postmortem write-up:
- Timeline: build -> attempted push -> replication 502 -> canary started -> canary 5xx -> auto rollback failed (artifact not found) -> manual set image to stable -> restore service -> incidence of helm/rollback failures and chart CDN 404s needs separate SRE follow-up.
- Action items: pipeline hardening, registry replication alerting, use image digests for canary, improve rollback runbook to include manual digest pin method.

End of scratchpad.

(rough, will move to a proper postmortem doc once I confirm registry root cause)
